title: Newmark Arranges $97.5 Million Sale of Willow Oaks Medical Campus in Fairfax, VA
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the $97.5 million sale of the Willow Oaks Medical Campus, a 382,850-square-foot, two-building portfolio of medical office buildings (“MOB”).
